D1-248.ctx: Ek university ka admissions model dehati schools ke applicants ko kam potential wala rate karta hai. Training data mein bohat kam dehati students the.
opts: Dehati data shamil karna aur groups ke nateeje milana
Model ke scores admissions staff se chupayein
Sirf model ka size aur us ki training ka waqt barhana
Ek saal tak dehati schools ki darkhwastein lena band karna
D1-248.exp: Model unfair hai kyunke training data mein ek group ki numaindagi kam hai. Munasib data shamil karna aur har group ke nateeje naapna wajah ko hal karta hai aur dikhata hai ke farq kam hua ya nahi. Scores chupana, model bara karna ya dehati applicants ko nikaalna bias theek nahi karta, aur dehati applicants ko nikaalna nuqsan barha deta hai.

D1-249.q: Har misaal ko us nuqsan ki qism se milayein jo woh dikhati hai. Nuqsan ki har qism ek baar istemal ho sakti hai, ya bilkul nahi.
items: Loan model ek group ke utni hi qabliyat wale applicants ko kam approve karta hai
Speech app khaas accents wale bolne walon ke liye bohat zyada ghaltiyan karti hai
Chatbot doosre customer ke ghar ka pata bata deta hai
D1-249.exp: Allocation harm tab hota hai jab system mauqay ya wasail, jaise loan, na-insaafi se de ya rok le. Quality-of-service harm tab hota hai jab system ek group ke liye doosre se kharab kaam kare, jaise kuch accents ke liye zyada error rate. Kisi ka pata bata dena privacy breach hai. In mein se koi transparency ka feature nahi.

D1-250.q: In mein se kya generative AI app mein safety ke iqdam ki misaal hai?
opts: Company ka bara logo
App ke developers ke liye tez laptop
Nuqsan deh requests ke liye content filters
App ki chat window ke liye naya color theme
D1-250.exp: Nuqsan deh content, jaise self-harm ki hidayaat, block karne se app ke nuqsan pohanchane ka khatra kam hota hai, jo reliability and safety ka hissa hai. Logo, laptop aur color theme se AI system ki safety nahi badalti.

D1-251.q: Reliability and safety ke baare mein neeche diye gaye har bayan ke liye, agar bayan sach hai to Haan chunein, warna Nahi chunein.
stmts: Fallback muqarrar karna, jaise user ko insan ke hawale karna, safety behtar karta hai.
Jo system testing mein theek chale woh production mein hamesha usi tarah chalega.
Release ke baad AI system ko monitor karna reliability and safety ka hissa hai.
D1-251.exp: Pehle ka jawab Haan: jab system halaat na sambhal sake to mehfooz fallback nuqsan ko mehdood karta hai. Doosre ka Nahi: asal users naye inputs laate hain, data waqt ke saath badalta hai aur models update hote hain, is liye rawaiya testing se mukhtalif ho sakta hai. Teesre ka Haan: monitoring release ke baad kharabiyan aur drift pakarti hai.

D1-252.ctx: Ek HR chatbot tamam employee records par grounded hai. Koi bhi employee us se doosre employees ki tankhwah pooch kar jawab le sakta hai.
D1-252.q: Kaunsa principle khatre mein hai, aur kya karna chahiye?
opts: Inclusiveness: mazeed zabanein shamil karein
Transparency: label lagayein ke jawab AI se aate hain
Fairness: tamam departments ke mazeed data par model train karna
Privacy and security: har user ki retrieval ko us ki permissions tak rakhna
D1-252.exp: Doosron ki tankhwah zahir karna privacy and security ki nakami hai. Retrieval ko har user ki ijazat ka khayal rakhna chahiye taake chatbot sirf woh data istemal kare jo woh shakhs dekh sakta hai. Mazeed zabanein, AI labels ya dobara training khufia records ka leak nahi rokte.

D1-253.q: Har khali jagah ke liye sahi option chun kar jumlay mukammal karein.
D1-253.tpl: Chat logs save hone se pehle phone numbers chupana {0} ki hifazat karta hai. Users ko apne records dekhne se pehle sign in karwana {1} ka control hai.
D1-253.exp: Zaati data chupana logon ki privacy ki hifazat karta hai, aur rasai se pehle authentication security ka control hai. Dono privacy and security principle mein aate hain. Inclusiveness, transparency aur fairness doosri baaton ke liye hain: accessibility, samajh aur barabar sulook.

D1-254.q: AI app mein kaunsa design intikhab inclusiveness ko sab se behtar support karta hai?
opts: Maloomat sirf tasveeron mein dikhayein, text ke baghair
Keyboard navigation aur screen readers ko support karein
Users ko tezi se type karne par majboor karein
Sirf ek zaban support karein
D1-254.exp: Keyboard navigation aur screen reader support se dekhne ya harkat ki dushwari wale log app istemal kar sakte hain, yahi inclusive design hai. Sirf tasveeron wala content na-beena users ko bahar kar deta hai, raftar ki shart harkat ki dushwari walon ko, aur ek zaban doosri zabanein bolne walon ko.

D1-255.q: Kaunse TEEN amal voice assistant ko zyada inclusive banate hain? Har sahi jawab mukammal hal hai.
opts: Sirf ek accent support karna
Bolne ki dushwari wale logon ke saath assistant test karna
Jawabon se captions hatana
Voice input ke badle text ka raasta dena
Kai zabanein aur lehje support karna
D1-255.exp: Bolne mein mushkil wale logon ke saath test karna, text input ka option dena aur kai zabanein aur lehje support karna, teenon rukawatein hatate hain, is liye zyada log assistant istemal kar sakte hain. Sirf ek lehja support karna aur captions hatana logon ko bahar kar dete hain.

D1-256.ctx: Ek recruiting tool job candidates ko rank karta hai. Reject hone wale candidates poochte hain ke un ki rank kam kyun thi, aur company nateeje samjha nahi sakti.
D1-256.q: Responsible AI ki is fikr ko hal karne ke liye company ko kya karna chahiye?
opts: Rankings ko logs aur reports se hata dena
Har role ke liye rank hone wale candidates ki tadad barhana
Har ranking ki asal wajuhaat samjhana
Nateeje wale page ka font badlein
D1-256.exp: AI ke faislon se mutasir log unhein samajh sakein, yahi transparency hai. Rankings ki wajoohat samjhana aur system ka maqsad aur hudood likhna is ko hal karta hai, aur na-insaafi wale patterns pakarne mein bhi madad deta hai. Logs hatane se accountability kam hoti hai, aur candidates ki tadad ya font se kuch samajh nahi aata.

D1-257.q: Transparency ke baare mein neeche diye gaye har bayan ke liye, agar bayan sach hai to Haan chunein, warna Nahi chunein.
stmts: System ki hudood samjhana transparency ko kam karta hai.
Transparency logon ko yeh tay karne mein madad karti hai ke AI system par kitna bharosa karein.
Agar kisi insan ne maanga ho to AI ke bane content par label ki zaroorat nahi.
D1-257.exp: Pehle ka jawab Nahi: hudood bayan karna transparency ka asal hissa hai, us ki kami nahi. Doosre ka Haan: system kaise kaam karta hai aur kahan fail ho sakta hai, yeh samajhne se log us par munasib bharosa karte hain. Teesre ka Nahi: AI ke bane content par label logon ko batata hai ke woh kya dekh rahe hain, un logon ko bhi jo usay baad mein dekhein.

D1-258.q: Microsoft mein kaunsa group company ki responsible AI policies banata aur un ki nigrani karta hai?
opts: Office of Responsible AI
Marketing aur communications team
Har end user
AI model khud
D1-258.exp: Microsoft ka Office of Responsible AI company ke responsible AI usool aur governance tay karta hai, jo wazeh ownership ke zariye accountability ki misaal hai. Marketing teams, alag alag users aur models khud is ke zimmedar nahi ke AI kaise banaya aur deploy kiya jaye.

D1-259.q: Har tareeqe ko us responsible AI principle se milayein jise woh sab se seedha support karta hai. Har principle ek baar istemal ho sakta hai, ya bilkul nahi.
items: Har AI system ke liye ek jawabdeh owner muqarrar karna
Har demographic group ke liye error rates naapna
Users ko samjhana ke system kaunsa data istemal karta hai
Mehfooz prompts aur responses ko encrypt karna
D1-259.exp: Muqarrar aur jawabdeh owner accountability hai. Groups ke error rates compare karna fairness check karta hai. Users ko batana ke system kaunsa data istemal karta hai transparency hai. Mehfooz data encrypt karna privacy and security hai. Inclusiveness har salahiyat aur pas-manzar ke logon ke liye design karne ke baare mein hai, jo in mein se kisi tareeqe ka maqsad nahi.

D1-260.q: Generative AI riwayati classification model se kaise mukhtalif hai?
opts: Woh sirf hisaab kar sakta hai
Usay training data nahi chahiye kyunke woh apne usool khud likhta hai
Sirf mobile phones par chalta hai aur kabhi cloud servers par nahi
Woh sirf label lagane ke bajaye naya content banata hai
D1-260.exp: Classification model label predict karta hai, jaise spam hai ya nahi, jab ke generative model naya content banata hai, jaise likha hua jawab, code ya tasveer. Generative models bare datasets par train hote hain, hisaab tak mehdood nahi aur aam taur par cloud mein chalte hain.

D1-261.q: Chat model ko ek hi prompt do baar bhejne par jawab mukhtalif kyun ho sakte hain?
opts: Model requests ke darmiyan apni training bhool jata hai
Tokens kuch randomness ke saath chune jate hain
Deployment har baar alag region mein chali jati hai
Har request ke baad quota reset hota hai
D1-261.exp: Generation har agla token probability distribution se chunti hai, aur temperature 0 se zyada ho to us intikhab mein kuch randomness hoti hai, is liye har run mein alfaz badal sakte hain. Model apni training nahi bhoolta, deployments requests ke darmiyan nahi hiltin, aur quota content par asar nahi dalta.

D1-262.q: Language models kaise kaam karte hain, is ke baare mein neeche diye gaye har bayan ke liye, agar bayan sach hai to Haan chunein, warna Nahi chunein.
stmts: Prompt mein hidayaat ki tarteeb aur alfaz jawab badal sakte hain.
Embeddings ek jaise mani ke bajaye ek jaisi spelling wale text ko qareeb rakhti hain.
Language models hu-ba-hu keywords milate hain aur ham-mani alfaaz nahi samajhte.
D1-262.exp: Pehle ka jawab Haan: models is par hassas hote hain ke prompts kaise likhe aur tarteeb diye gaye hain. Doosre ka Nahi: embeddings ek jaise mani wale text ko vector space mein qareeb rakhti hain, isi liye woh semantic search ke liye mufeed hain. Teesre ka Nahi: models alfaz ke aapas ke taalluq aur context seekhte hain, is liye woh hu-ba-hu keywords par munhasir hone ke bajaye hum-maani alfaz aur badli hui jumla-bandi samajh lete hain.

D1-263.q: Embeddings ke baare mein jumlay mukammal karein.
D1-263.tpl: 'dog' aur 'puppy' ke embedding vectors, 'dog' aur 'invoice' ke vectors ke muqable mein, ek doosre se {0} hote hain. Do vectors ko compare karne ka aam tareeqa {1} hai.
D1-263.exp: Mutalliqa matlab wale alfaz, jaise dog aur puppy, ke vectors milti simt mein hote hain, is liye woh ghair mutalliqa alfaz se zyada qareeb hote hain. Cosine similarity naapta hai ke do vectors kitni ek hi simt mein hain. Temperature aur top P generation ki settings hain, mushabihat naapne ke tareeqay nahi.

D1-264.q: Solution design karte waqt generative models ki kaunsi TEEN hudood ka khayal rakhna chahiye? Har sahi jawab mukammal hal hai.
opts: Woh hamesha apne sources cite karte hain
Woh ghalat maloomat pur-aetemad andaz mein de sakte hain
Unhein kabhi monitoring nahi chahiye
Un ki andruni maloomat training cutoff par khatam ho jati hai
Woh apne training data ka bias dohra sakte hain
D1-264.exp: Generative models ghalat maloomat yaqeen ke saath bata sakte hain, ground kiye baghair training cutoff ke baad ki baat nahi jaante, aur apne training data ka bias dohra sakte hain. Woh hamesha sources nahi batate, aur kisi bhi system ki tarah unhein monitoring chahiye.

D1-265.ctx: Ek model se un regulations ka khulasa karne ko kaha gaya jo 2026 mein badli thin, lekin woh purane usool bayan karta hai.
D1-265.q: Sab se mumkina wajah aur behtareen hal kya hai?
opts: Temperature bohat kam hai; usay barhayein
Deployment ka naam ghalat hai; naam badal kar prompt dobara bhejein
Training data pehle khatam hota hai; prompt ko taaza documents se ground karein
Quota bohat zyada hai; kam karein jab tak model naye usool na parh le
D1-265.exp: Model sirf wahi janta hai jo us ke training data mein tha, is liye cutoff ke baad ki tabdeeliyan usay maloom nahi. Prompt mein maujooda documents dena, maslan retrieval ke zariye, khulase ko taaza content par mabni karta hai. Temperature, deployment ke naam aur quota model ko nayi maloomat nahi dete.

D1-266.q: Aap ko das lakh chhote support tickets kam se kam kharche mein paanch aasan categories mein baantne hain. Kaunsa model sab se munasib hai?
opts: Chhota, sasta model
Sab se bara available reasoning model
Image-generation model
Speech-synthesis model
D1-266.exp: Zyada tadad mein aasan classification ke liye chhota model munasib hai, jo tez aur fi token sasta hota hai aur wazeh categories ke liye kaafi sahi bhi. Bara reasoning model aisa kharcha aur latency barhata hai jo is kaam ko nahi chahiye, aur image ya speech models text tickets classify nahi kar sakte.

D1-267.q: Ek law firm ko aisa chat model chahiye jo Arabic aur Japanese mein sawalon ke jawab de. Model ki kaunsi khoobi sab se pehle check karni chahiye?
opts: Us ke logo ka rang
Us ke release ka maheena
Pichle hafte kitni baar download hua
Woh Arabic aur Japanese ko kitni achi tarah support karta hai
D1-267.exp: Zaban ka support aur quality models ke darmiyan mukhtalif hoti hai, is liye model card dekhein aur Arabic aur Japanese prompts se test karein. Logo, release ka maheena ya downloads yeh nahi batate ke model woh zabanein achi tarah sambhalta hai ya nahi.

D1-268.q: Deployment types ke baare mein neeche diye gaye har bayan ke liye, agar bayan sach hai to Haan chunein, warna Nahi chunein.
stmts: Data Zone deployments processing ko ek geographic zone, jaise EU, ke andar rakhti hain.
Global Batch un bare kaamon ke liye bana hai jinhein foran jawab nahi chahiye.
Standard deployments processing ko deployment ke region wali Azure geography ke andar rakhti hain.
D1-268.exp: Pehle ka jawab Haan: Data Zone types processing ko EU ya US jaise zone ke andar rakhti hain. Doosre ka Haan: Global Batch asynchronous hai aur us ka target waqt 24 ghante tak hai, is liye woh live chat ke bajaye bulk jobs ke liye munasib hai. Teesre ka Haan: Standard geography par mabni type hai, is liye prompts aur responses usi Azure geography mein process hote hain.

D1-269.q: Har zaroorat ko us qism ke model se milayein jo us ke liye sab se munasib hai. Model ki har qism ek baar istemal ho sakti hai, ya bilkul nahi.
items: Search box ke liye documents ko matlab ke hisaab se rank karna
Tax ke mushkil, kai qadam wale sawal ka sahi jawab dena
Aasan FAQ sawalon ka kam latency ke saath jawab dena
Photo mein kya hai yeh bayan karna
D1-269.exp: Semantic ranking embeddings istemal karti hai, mushkil kai qadam wale masail mein reasoning model faida deta hai, aasan aur tez jawabon ke liye chhota chat model munasib hai, aur photos bayan karne ke liye multimodal model chahiye. Text-to-speech model audio banata hai aur in mein se kisi zaroorat par nahi aata.

D1-270.q: Ek model ki context window 128,000 tokens hai. Aap ka prompt pehle hi 126,000 tokens istemal karta hai, aur aap 4,000 tak output tokens maangte hain. Kya hota hai?
opts: Request fail hoti hai kyunke window se bari hai
Model is request ke liye khud-ba-khud mazeed context shamil karta hai
Request ke mutabiq quota khud-ba-khud barh jata hai
Output tokens muft hote hain
D1-270.exp: Context window input aur output dono ko mila kar hoti hai, is liye 126,000 aur 4,000 tokens mil kar 128,000 ki hadd se zyada hain aur service request reject karti hai. Aap ko chhota prompt, kam output tokens ya bari window wala model chahiye. Context khud nahi barhta, quota ka is se taalluq nahi, aur output tokens ka bill aata hai.

D1-271.q: Request parameters ke baare mein jumlay mukammal karein.
D1-271.tpl: Model END jaise nishan par pohanch kar ruk jaye, is ke liye {0} istemal karein. Lambe jawab dene ke liye {1} barhayein.
D1-271.exp: Stop sequence muqarrar string par generation khatam karta hai. Max tokens jawab ki lambai ki upri hadd set karta hai, is liye usay barhane se lambe jawab milte hain. Seed output ko qabil-e-dohrai banane par asar dalta hai, temperature aur top P randomness par, aur frequency penalty takrar kam karta hai.

D1-272.q: Kaunsi DO cheezein request parameters hain jo app har call par set karti hai, na ke deployment ki settings? Har sahi jawab mukammal hal hai.
D1-272.exp: Temperature aur maximum output tokens har request ke saath jate hain aur har call mein mukhtalif ho sakte hain. Deployment type, tokens-per-minute quota aur content filter configuration deployment par set hote hain aur us ki tamam requests par lagu hote hain.

D1-273.q: top P ko 0.1 set karne se kya hota hai?
opts: Kam mufeed alfaaz hata kar jawab 10% chhota karta hai
10% requests filter ho jati hain
Sirf woh sab se mumkina tokens rakhta hai jo mil kar 10% probability banate hain
Dastiyab GPUs ka 10% istemal karta hai taake requests sasti hon
D1-273.exp: Top P, yaani nucleus sampling, sirf sab se mumkina tokens ka woh sab se chhota set dekhta hai jin ki mila kar probability di gayi value, yahan 10%, tak pohanche, is liye output zyada markooz hota hai. Woh lambai nahi badalta, requests filter nahi karta aur hardware control nahi karta.

D1-274.q: Aap ne Microsoft Foundry mein model fine-tune kiya. Aap ki apps ke us model ko istemal karne se pehle kya hona zaroori hai?
opts: Kuch nahi; woh apps ko khud dastiyab ho jata hai
Base model delete karna
Resource ko doosre region mein le jana
Fine-tuned model ko deploy karna
D1-274.exp: Fine-tuning job naya custom model banati hai, jise phir aap deploy karte hain taake apps usay deployment ke naam se call karein. Woh khud live nahi hota, base model delete nahi hota, aur region badalna is amal ka hissa nahi.
